newsitem.title: USA: Orthodontic Centers names Faux president.
newsitem.headline: Orthodontic Centers names Faux president.

text.p: Orthodontic Centers of America Inc said Tuesday that chief administrative officer Geoffrey Faux will assume the office of president, and vice president of operations Michael Johnsen will become chief operating officer.
Dr. Gasper Lazzara Jr will continue as chairman and chief executive officer.

"By every measure, our company has achieved phenomenal growth, exceeding even our optimistic expectations," said Lazzara. "To enhance this growth, we feel it is the appropriate time to expand the executive management team of our company so that we have senior leadership focused on all critical areas of responsibility."
